title: Local tier escalation
finding: Re-scored the 464 Experiment 33 local OCR rows (no new OCR). No candidate passes all three gates. C0 (shipped, cut 0.8) escalates 0.469 and keeps 1 of 129 non-Latin pages (`io02` p13, confidence 0.8046); G1 and G2 fail (kept-bad 0.106 without `io06`). C1 (CJK share ≥ 0.05) escalates 105 of 108 Devanagari and Bengali pages but keeps 16 of 21 Arabic pages (output is Latin fragments) and 19 of 129 in all. C3 adds one page to C0. Only the 0.9 cut passes G1 and G2, and it fails G3 (0.596 against 0.566). `io06` stays open: C0 escalates 5 of 13 bad pages; characters-per-page AUC 0.788, below the 0.8 trigger. Follow-up (2026-10-07): the operator chose 0.9 in a separate change and accepted the G3 miss. The experiment remains FAIL. See [operator decision](./39-local-tier-escalation-2026-09-30/report.md#follow-up-decision-2026-10-07)
